tool_input.command: cat data/scoring_request.md; echo "---MODEL---"; cat data/model.json; echo "---HEAD---"; head -20 data/feature_history.csv; echo "---WC---"; wc -l data/feature_history.csv
hops --help
hops fg --help; echo "==SQL=="; hops sql --help
hops fg create --help; echo "==DERIVE=="; hops fg derive --help
tool_input.description: Show fg create and derive help

tool_input.command: hops fg insert --help
hops context 2>&1 | head -40

hops fg create feat_hist_raw --version 1 --primary-key account_id,event_time --event-time event_time --features "account_id:string,event_time:bigint,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double" --description "Raw feature history for batch scoring" --json 2>&1 | tail -30
hops fg insert feat_hist_raw --version 1 --file data/feature_history.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -25
tool_input.description: Insert CSV into raw feature group

tool_input.command: hops sql "SELECT count(*) AS n, count(distinct account_id) AS accts FROM feat_hist_raw_1" --json 2>&1 | tail -20
tool_input.description: Count rows in raw FG via Trino

tool_input.command: hops sql --no-verify "SELECT count(*) AS n, count(distinct account_id) AS accts FROM feat_hist_raw_1" --json 2>&1 | tail -20
tool_input.description: Count rows in raw FG via Trino with no-verify

tool_input.command: hops sql --no-verify "SHOW TABLES" --json 2>&1 | tail -20
tool_input.description: List Trino tables in default schema

tool_input.command: hops trino catalogs --no-verify --json 2>&1 | tail -15
hops fg preview feat_hist_raw --version 1 --no-verify --json 2>&1 | tail -25
hops sql --no-verify --catalog hudi "SELECT count(*) AS n, count(distinct account_id) AS accts, min(event_time) mn, max(event_time) mx FROM feat_hist_raw_1" --json 2>&1 | tail -12
hops sql --no-verify --catalog hudi "SHOW SCHEMAS" --json 2>&1 | tail -25
hops sql --no-verify --catalog hudi --schema mlpabc31ad7_featurestore "SHOW TABLES" --json 2>&1 | tail -15
hops sql --no-verify --catalog hudi --schema mlpabc31ad7_featurestore "SELECT count(*) AS n, count(distinct account_id) AS accts FROM feat_hist_raw_1" --json 2>&1 | tail -8
hops sql --no-verify --catalog iceberg --schema mlpabc31ad7_featurestore "SELECT count(*) AS n, count(distinct account_id) AS accts FROM feat_hist_raw_1" --json 2>&1 | tail -8
tool_input.description: Count rows in iceberg featurestore schema

tool_input.command: for c in hive hive_hops offline; do echo "== $c =="; hops sql --no-verify --catalog $c "SHOW SCHEMAS" --json 2>&1 | grep -E '"Schema"|TrinoUserError|not found|Catalog' | head -5; done
hops sql --no-verify --catalog hive --schema mlpabc31ad7_featurestore "SELECT count(*) AS n, count(distinct account_id) AS accts FROM feat_hist_raw_1" --json 2>&1 | tail -8

for c in delta delta_lake deltalake; do echo "== $c =="; hops sql --no-verify --catalog $c "SELECT 1" --json 2>&1 | grep -E 'PERMISSION_DENIED|not found|Catalog .* does not|^\[|"_col0"|TrinoUserError' | head -3; done
hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpabc31ad7_featurestore "SELECT count(*) AS n, count(distinct account_id) AS accts FROM feat_hist_raw_1" --json 2>&1 | tail -8

hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpabc31ad7_featurestore --json "
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT account_id, f1, f2, f3,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS rn
  FROM feat_hist_raw_1
  WHERE event_time <= 1773309600000
)
SELECT account_id,
       ROUND(1.0/(1.0+EXP(-(0.9258*f1 + (-0.1745)*f2 + (-0.6843)*f3 + 0.0704))), 6) AS score
FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY account_id
" 2>&1 | tail -40

hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpabc31ad7_featurestore --json "SELECT count(distinct account_id) AS accts_with_valid FROM feat_hist_raw_1 WHERE event_time <= 1773309600000" 2>&1 | tail -6
tool_input.description: Count accounts with revision at or before T

tool_input.command:
mkdir -p .tmp; hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpabc31ad7_featurestore --limit 0 --json "
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT account_id, f1, f2, f3,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS rn
  FROM feat_hist_raw_1
  WHERE event_time <= 1773309600000
)
SELECT account_id,
       ROUND(1.0/(1.0+EXP(-(0.9258*f1 + (-0.1745)*f2 + (-0.6843)*f3 + 0.0704))), 6) AS score
FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
" 1>.tmp/scores.json 2>.tmp/scores.err; echo "exit=$?"; wc -c .tmp/scores.json; grep -c account_id .tmp/scores.json
tool_input.description: Save scoring query results to file

tool_input.command: head -c 300 .tmp/scores.json; echo; echo "..."; tail -c 150 .tmp/scores.json

hops fg create scoresa4a614 --version 1 --primary-key account_id --features "account_id:string,score:double" --online --description "Batch logistic scores as of T=1773309600000" --no-verify --json 2>&1 | tail -20
hops fg insert scoresa4a614 --version 1 --file .tmp/scores.json --no-verify --json 2>&1 | tail -12

echo "== schema/info =="; hops fg info scoresa4a614 --version 1 --no-verify --json 2>&1 | grep -E '"name"|"online_enabled"|"primary' | head; echo "== preview =="; hops fg preview scoresa4a614 --version 1 --no-verify --json 2>&1 | tail -16
tool_input.description: Verify scores FG schema and data

tool_input.command: hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpabc31ad7_featurestore --json "SELECT count(*) n, count(distinct account_id) accts, min(score) mn, max(score) mx FROM scoresa4a614_1" 2>&1 | tail -8
